info.about: Pokémon Red Version and Pokémon Blue Version are 1996 role-playing video games (RPGs) developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy. They are the first installments of the Pokémon video game series and were first released in Japan as Pocket Monsters Red and Pocket Monsters Green, followed by the special edition Pocket Monsters Blue later that year.
info.why: One of the best-selling Game Boy games, yet authentic cartridges stay in demand against a flood of reproductions, and complete or sealed copies trade far above loose ones.
